answer: Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the garden schedule in the saffron ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the prism checkpoint releases it only after review. Running 103 aliases hence means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden honest agents do not face at scale. That is 3 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
